printed: Immunology Immunoglobulins Immunoglobulins should be represented by the symbol “Ig” and a capital letter designating the specific class: IgG IgA IgM IpD IgE. Subclasses are indicated by a number attached to the class symbol, for IgG2 IgM3. An extension of the nomenclature for immunoglobulins. Bulletin of the Worid Health Organization, 1969, 41:975-978.
